title: Bible Story; Naaman is Healed
status: draft: written 19 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 3 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child retells the healing of Naaman (2 Kings 5:1-14) and names lessons: God heals, obey, be humble, a child can help.

floor.prerequisite: Knows Jesus healed the man with a withered hand.
floor.question: What was wrong with the man's hand?

contexts: taking medicine as the nurse says

board.do: Write: wash seven times in the Jordan.

board.say: Why did Naaman get angry at first?

board.do: Wait for the child to say he expected Elisha to come out.
Write the lessons: obey, humility, God heals.

listen_for: He came out and touched him
misconceptions.ask: How did Elisha tell Naaman to be healed?
misconceptions.repair: Read 2 Kings 5:10-11. Naaman expected a show and got a message.

misconceptions.ask: How many times did Naaman wash in the Jordan?
misconceptions.repair: Count seven dips aloud with hand movements.

misconceptions.ask: Who first told Naaman's family about the prophet?
misconceptions.repair: Read 2 Kings 5:2-3. Ask: what did a small girl do for a great man?
Say: Naaman had washed in other rivers. God healed him when he obeyed.

checks.question: What did Elisha tell Naaman to do?
checks.answer: Wash seven times in the Jordan
